Gluten-free cereal a celiac can trust.summary: Only one cereal in the catalog cleared the checks for a celiac shopper: Kroger Crispy Rice Cereal, which declares wheat free and makes a gluten-free claim with no gluten ingredients listed. No product in the catalog carries a third-party gluten-free certification, so the claim rests on the retailer's own labeling. Check the package and your own celiac guidance before buying.
